title: Financial Instruments: Presentation
intro: IAS 32 يحدد: الأداة **التزام** ولا **حقوق ملكية**؟ حسب جوهر العقد مش شكله القانوني.
الأداة المركبة (زي السندات القابلة للتحويل) تتقسم: الالتزام أولاً بالقيمة الحالية، وحقوق الملكية هي **الباقي**.

tf.s: Mandatorily redeemable preference shares are financial liabilities.
tf.why: There is a contractual obligation to pay cash.

tf.s: A convertible bond is split into a liability component and an equity component.
The equity component of a compound instrument is measured first at fair value.
tf.why: The liability is measured first; equity is the residual.

tf.s: Treasury shares are deducted from equity; no gain or loss goes to profit or loss.
tf.why: Transactions in own shares are in equity.

tf.s: Dividends on shares classified as liabilities are presented as interest expense.
Financial assets and liabilities may be offset whenever they are with the same counterparty.
tf.why: Need a legally enforceable right and intention to settle net.

fill.s: In a compound instrument, the equity component is the ___ amount.
Mandatorily redeemable preference shares are financial ___.
Offsetting needs a legally enforceable ___ to set off.

source: Written for IFRS Play from the standard's core requirements. Exact source reference could not be verified from the uploaded document.

je.s: 5% preference shares with mandatory redemption are issued for 100,000 cash.
je.why: Mandatory redemption = contractual obligation to pay cash.

je.s: The company buys back its own shares for 30,000 cash.
je.why: Own shares are deducted from equity, not assets.

calc.s: A convertible bond is issued for 1,000,000. The PV of the liability component is 920,000. Equity component?
Redeemable preference shares 200,000 with a 6% dividend. Amount shown as finance cost?
calc.why: Classified as a liability, so the dividend is interest: 6% x 200,000.

seq.s: رتّب خطوات محاسبة السندات القابلة للتحويل
steps: Measure the liability: PV of cash flows at the market rate without conversion
Unwind the liability at the effective rate
On conversion, transfer the liability to equity

items: Obligation to deliver shares worth exactly 100,000

multi.s: Offsetting a financial asset and liability requires: (select all)
opts: A legally enforceable right to set off
Intention to settle net or simultaneously
multi.why: Both conditions are needed; the others are not enough.
